entries.77b1fdee4b246ab9: This service supports the purchase and sale of used semiconductor manufacturing equipment. Field engineers handle everything from dismantling, removal and installation of equipment to process tuning as needed, and it deals mainly with equipment used in front-end processes. Sales for the fiscal year ended November 2025 were ¥7,403 million. Lead time from order to revenue recognition is several months to one year, but revenue recognition is highly certain.
entries.8b6b275f398a0024: A company that sells and repairs parts for semiconductor manufacturing equipment and sells used equipment, supporting the operation of semiconductor factories.
entries.aa22bc0ffa808ee6: This service sells and repairs semiconductor manufacturing equipment parts, using the cross-border EC site 'LAYLA-EC' and other channels. More than 200 suppliers worldwide are registered on 'LAYLA-EC,' and over 369,000 items are listed (as of November 30, 2025). It also supplies new consumable parts, and since repeat orders are expected once an order is received, this is a stable source of revenue. Sales for the fiscal year ended November 2025 were ¥1,213 million.
entries.c426a47f861d3d19: This is the only reportable segment of the company group, consisting of the company and one consolidated subsidiary (TMH KOREA Inc.). Its main business is the sale and repair of semiconductor manufacturing equipment and parts. It combines a mechanism that aggregates information on equipment and parts worldwide through the cross-border EC site 'LAYLA-EC' with engineering capabilities, such as dismantling, removal and installation of equipment by field engineers, and supports the operation of semiconductor factories mainly in the domestic market, where many semiconductor plants are older models. Revenue for the fiscal year ended November 2025 was ¥8,628 million.
